car.name: Navelwort 1978
car.description: Markku Alén / Ilkka Kivimäki, 1978 1000 Lakes-winning Fiat 131 Abarth Rally Group 4 inspiration. Front-engine 1995 cc naturally aspirated four, rear drive and five-speed manual. Original ochre/forest rally art; competition setup estimates are labeled, not Stradale figures.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: Markku Alén / Ilkka Kivimäki, 1978 1000 Lakes Rally-winning Fiat 131 Abarth Rally Group 4. Not road Stradale or later evolution calibration.

sources.access: Organizer winners list explicitly confirms 1978 Alén/Kivimäki in Fiat 131 Abarth.
FIA homologation 647: Group 4, 1995 cc, four cylinders, RWD. Not a later drivetrain.

Manufacturer heritage describes competition two-litre with Kugelfischer injection replacing road Weber carburetor, and over 230 horsepower across development. Broad retrospective, not exact Finland 1978 power.

Heritage 1977 exhibit confirms DOHC 16-valve four and five gears, independent rear suspension. Its 215 hp/carburetor wording conflicts with competition-injection history; not treated as exact 1978 event specification.

verifiedFacts.engineLayout: front longitudinal naturally aspirated DOHC 16-valve inline-four

estimates: 227 mechanical hp is an illustrative 230 PS-class competition target, not a verified 1978 Finland dyno figure. Manufacturer retrospective says over 230 horsepower across development; conflicting 215 hp exhibit wording is not silently combined. Competition uses Kugelfischer injection, not Stradale carburetor calibration.

1000 kg, 170 lb-ft, complete torque curve, RPM thresholds, 118 mph and 6.5 s 0–60 targets are simulation estimates. Five-speed manual is documented architecture; exact ratios, final drive, shift behavior, differential, dimensions, mass distribution, suspension, brakes, aero, 80 L tank and 185/70R15 gravel tires are approximate game setup, not verified event-day equipment.

Original ochre/forest/cream eight-view body, silver gravel wheels and stripped felt dashboard are interpretations with no copied sponsor livery. Live digital gauges, shared steering wheel/wipers and generic sound are game conventions. Auto Assist is accessibility, not factory automatic. Original PNGs retained; native opacity normalization affects only decoded wheel copy.
